===== FILE: OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/01_openfoam_env_test.slurm =====
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=of_env_test
#SBATCH --partition=orfoz
#SBATCH --exclude=orfoz359
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=56
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --time=00:05:00
#SBATCH --output=of_env_test_%j.out
#SBATCH --error=of_env_test_%j.err

echo "CHECKPOINT 1: batch script started"
echo "Node: $(hostname)"
echo "Job: $SLURM_JOB_ID"
echo

echo "CHECKPOINT 2: before module purge"
module purge
echo "module purge rc=$?"

echo
echo "CHECKPOINT 3: before OpenFOAM module"
module load apps/openfoam/v2312
echo "module load rc=$?"

echo
echo "CHECKPOINT 4: OpenFOAM environment"
echo "WM_PROJECT_VERSION=${WM_PROJECT_VERSION:-unset}"
echo "WM_PROJECT_DIR=${WM_PROJECT_DIR:-unset}"
echo "WM_MPLIB=${WM_MPLIB:-unset}"

echo
echo "CHECKPOINT 5: executables"
for exe in blockMesh checkMesh decomposePar reconstructPar rhoReactingFoam mpirun; do
    printf "%-24s : " "$exe"
    command -v "$exe" || echo "NOT FOUND"
done

echo
echo "CHECKPOINT 6: MPI version"
mpirun --version | head -n 3

echo
echo "OPENFOAM ENVIRONMENT TEST PASSED"

===== FILE: OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/cases/FLOW/BC1_LOW_v005/M1_108x36/C1/system/blockMeshDict =====
/*--------------------------------*- C++ -*----------------------------------*\
  OpenFOAM v2312 - 2D opposed-flow mesh: Nx=108, Ny=36
  Geometry: 20 mm x 20 mm; centered inlet width = 1/11 of domain width.
\*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
FoamFile
{
    version     2.0;
    format      ascii;
    class       dictionary;
    object      blockMeshDict;
}

convertToMeters 1;

vertices
(
    (0.0         -0.01 -0.01)
    (0.009090909 -0.01 -0.01)
    (0.010909091 -0.01 -0.01)
    (0.02        -0.01 -0.01)
    (0.02         0.01 -0.01)
    (0.010909091  0.01 -0.01)
    (0.009090909  0.01 -0.01)
    (0.0          0.01 -0.01)
    (0.0         -0.01  0.01)
    (0.009090909 -0.01  0.01)
    (0.010909091 -0.01  0.01)
    (0.02        -0.01  0.01)
    (0.02         0.01  0.01)
    (0.010909091  0.01  0.01)
    (0.009090909  0.01  0.01)
    (0.0          0.01  0.01)
);

blocks
(
    hex (0 1 6 7 8 9 14 15) (49 36 1) simpleGrading (1 1 1)
    hex (1 2 5 6 9 10 13 14) (10 36 1) simpleGrading (1 1 1)
    hex (2 3 4 5 10 11 12 13) (49 36 1) simpleGrading (1 1 1)
);

edges ();

boundary
(
    outlet
    {
        type patch;
        faces
        (
            (0 8 15 7)
            (3 4 12 11)
        );
    }

    fuelInlet
    {
        type patch;
        faces ((1 2 10 9));
    }

    walls
    {
        type wall;
        faces
        (
            (0 1 9 8)
            (2 3 11 10)
            (15 14 6 7)
            (13 12 4 5)
        );
    }

    oxidizerInlet
    {
        type patch;
        faces ((14 13 5 6));
    }

    frontAndBack
    {
        type empty;
        faces
        (
            (0 7 6 1)
            (1 6 5 2)
            (2 5 4 3)
            (8 9 14 15)
            (9 10 13 14)
            (10 11 12 13)
        );
    }
);

mergePatchPairs ();

// Total cells: 108 x 36 x 1 = 3888
// x-block cells: 49 | 10 | 49
// ************************************************************************* //



===== FILE: OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/cases/FLOW/BC1_LOW_v005/M1_108x36/C1/system/controlDict =====
/*--------------------------------*- C++ -*----------------------------------*\
  OpenFOAM v2312 - 96-case flow/stiffness/core validation campaign
\*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
FoamFile
{
    version     2.0;
    format      ascii;
    class       dictionary;
    location    "system";
    object      controlDict;
}

application     rhoReactingFoam;
startFrom       startTime;
startTime       0;
stopAt          endTime;
endTime         2.0;

deltaT          1e-7;
adjustTimeStep  yes;
maxCo           0.05;
maxDeltaT       1e-4;

// Default campaign writes the final field only. This avoids I/O dominating
// the serial/parallel timing comparison. Use set_history_mode.sh for histories.
writeControl    adjustableRunTime;
writeInterval   2.0;
purgeWrite      0;
writeFormat     binary;
writePrecision  10;
writeCompression off;
timeFormat      general;
timePrecision   8;
runTimeModifiable true;

// ************************************************************************* //



===== FILE: OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/cases/FLOW/BC1_LOW_v005/M1_108x36/C1/system/fvSchemes =====
/*--------------------------------*- C++ -*----------------------------------*\
  =========                 |
  \\      /  F ield         | OpenFOAM: The Open Source CFD Toolbox
   \\    /   O peration     | Website:  https://openfoam.org
    \\  /    A nd           | Version:  7  
     \\/     M anipulation  |
\*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
FoamFile
{
    version     2.0;
    format      ascii;
    class       dictionary;
    location    "system";
    object      fvSchemes;
}
// * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * //

ddtSchemes
{
    default         Euler;
}

gradSchemes
{
    default         Gauss linear;
}

divSchemes
{
    default         none;

    div(phi,U)      Gauss limitedLinearV 1;
    div(phi,Yi_h)   Gauss limitedLinear 1;
    div(phi,K)      Gauss limitedLinear 1;
    div(phid,p)     Gauss limitedLinear 1;
    div(phi,epsilon) Gauss limitedLinear 1;
    div(phi,k) Gauss limitedLinear 1;
    div(((rho*nuEff)*dev2(T(grad(U))))) Gauss linear;
}

laplacianSchemes
{
    default         Gauss linear orthogonal;
}

interpolationSchemes
{
    default         linear;
}

snGradSchemes
{
    default         orthogonal;
}

===== FILE: OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/cases/FLOW/BC1_LOW_v005/M1_108x36/C1/system/fvSolution =====
FoamFile
{
    version     2.0;
    format      ascii;
    class       dictionary;
    location    "system";
    object      fvSolution;
}

solvers
{
    #include "fvSolution.solvers"
}

PIMPLE
{
    nOuterCorrectors         1;
    nCorrectors              2;
    nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 0;

    momentumPredictor        yes;
    transonic                no;

    residualControl
    {
        p           1e-9;
        U           1e-9;
        h           1e-9;
        "(F|O|P|N2)" 1e-9;
    }
}

relaxationFactors
{
    fields { p 0.3; }
    equations
    {
        U               0.7;
        h               0.7;
        "(F|O|P|N2)"     0.7;
    }
}

    frontAndBack { type empty; }

   \\    /   O peration     | Website:  https://openfoam.org
    \\  /    A nd           | Version:  7  
     \\/     M anipulation  |
\*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
FoamFile
{
    version     2.0;
    format      ascii;
    class       dictionary;
    location    "system";
    object      fvSchemes;
}
// * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * //

ddtSchemes
{
    default         Euler;
}

gradSchemes
{
    default         Gauss linear;
}

divSchemes
{
    default         none;

    div(phi,U)      Gauss limitedLinearV 1;
    div(phi,Yi_h)   Gauss limitedLinear 1;
    div(phi,K)      Gauss limitedLinear 1;
    div(phid,p)     Gauss limitedLinear 1;
    div(phi,epsilon) Gauss limitedLinear 1;
    div(phi,k) Gauss limitedLinear 1;
    div(((rho*nuEff)*dev2(T(grad(U))))) Gauss linear;
}

laplacianSchemes
{
    default         Gauss linear orthogonal;
}

interpolationSchemes
{
    default         linear;
}

snGradSchemes
{
    default         orthogonal;
}

===== FILE: OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/openfoam96_orfoz_array.slurm =====
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=OF2312_96
#SBATCH --partition=orfoz
#SBATCH --exclude=orfoz359
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=56
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --exclusive
#SBATCH --time=3-00:00:00
#SBATCH --array=0-23%3
#SBATCH --output=slurm-OF2312_96_%A_%a.out
#SBATCH --error=slurm-OF2312_96_%A_%a.err

# Do not use `set -u` around the TRUBA OpenFOAM module environment.
set -o pipefail

# TRUBA-native OpenFOAM environment verified on an Orfoz compute node.
set +e
module purge
module load apps/openfoam/v2312
MODULE_RC=$?
set -e

echo "module load return code: ${MODULE_RC}"

# Validate the environment by variables/executables.  The foamVersion helper is
# not used here because it is not reliably exported into non-interactive jobs.
if [[ "${WM_PROJECT_VERSION:-}" != "v2312" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: expected WM_PROJECT_VERSION=v2312, got '${WM_PROJECT_VERSION:-unset}'" >&2
    exit 10
fi

required=(blockMesh checkMesh decomposePar reconstructPar rhoReactingFoam mpirun)
for exe in "${required[@]}"; do
    command -v "$exe" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
        echo "ERROR: required executable not found after module load: $exe" >&2
        exit 11
    }
done

# Intel MPI settings for the TRUBA v2312 module.
export I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=slurm
export I_MPI_PIN=1
export I_MPI_PIN_DOMAIN=core
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1

ROOT="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR}"
RUNNER="${ROOT}/run_case_orfoz.sh"

if [[ ! -d "$ROOT/cases" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: cases/ not found under SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR=$ROOT" >&2
    echo "Submit this script from the campaign root directory." >&2
    exit 12
fi
if [[ ! -f "$RUNNER" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: run_case_orfoz.sh not found under $ROOT" >&2
    exit 13
fi
if [[ ! -f "$ROOT/physical_configurations.txt" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: physical_configurations.txt not found under $ROOT" >&2
    exit 14
fi

cd "$ROOT"

LINE="$(sed -n "$((SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID + 1))p" "$ROOT/physical_configurations.txt")"
if [[ -z "$LINE" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: no physical configuration for array task ${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}" >&2
    exit 15
fi

read -r GROUP PHYSICAL_CASE MESH <<< "$LINE"
CORES=(C1 C2 C4 C16)

echo "============================================================"
echo "OPENFOAM V2312 ORFOZ CAMPAIGN"
echo "============================================================"
echo "Date:               $(date --iso-8601=seconds)"
echo "Node:               $(hostname)"
echo "Submit directory:   $ROOT"
echo "Job ID:             ${SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID:-${SLURM_JOB_ID}}"
echo "Array task:         ${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}"
echo "Configuration:      ${GROUP}/${PHYSICAL_CASE}/${MESH}"
echo "Reserved tasks:     ${SLURM_NTASKS}"
echo "OpenFOAM version:   ${WM_PROJECT_VERSION}"
echo "WM_PROJECT_DIR:     ${WM_PROJECT_DIR:-unknown}"
echo "WM_MPLIB:           ${WM_MPLIB:-unknown}"
echo "MPI:                $(command -v mpirun)"
echo "MPI sizes:          1, 2, 4, 16 (sequential)"
echo "Excluded node:      orfoz359"
echo "============================================================"

for C in "${CORES[@]}"; do
    CASE_DIR="$ROOT/cases/$GROUP/$PHYSICAL_CASE/$MESH/$C"

    if [[ ! -d "$CASE_DIR" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: case directory is missing: $CASE_DIR" >&2
        exit 16
    fi

    if [[ -f "$CASE_DIR/RUN_COMPLETE" ]]; then
        echo "SKIP completed: $GROUP/$PHYSICAL_CASE/$MESH/$C"
        continue
    fi

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "RUN $GROUP/$PHYSICAL_CASE/$MESH/$C"
    echo "START $(date --iso-8601=seconds)"
    echo "============================================================"

    bash "$RUNNER" "$CASE_DIR"
done

echo
echo "ARRAY TASK COMPLETE: $GROUP/$PHYSICAL_CASE/$MESH"
echo "END $(date --iso-8601=seconds)"



===== FILE: OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/OpenFOAM_v2312_TRUBA_CLEAN_96cases_1_2_4_16/openfoam_smoke_orfoz.slurm =====
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=OF2312_smoke
#SBATCH --partition=orfoz
#SBATCH --exclude=orfoz359
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=56
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --exclusive
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00
#SBATCH --output=slurm-OF2312_smoke_%j.out
#SBATCH --error=slurm-OF2312_smoke_%j.err

set -o pipefail
set +e
module purge
module load apps/openfoam/v2312
MODULE_RC=$?
set -e

echo "module load return code: ${MODULE_RC}"
[[ "${WM_PROJECT_VERSION:-}" == "v2312" ]] || { echo "ERROR: OpenFOAM v2312 environment missing" >&2; exit 10; }
for exe in blockMesh checkMesh decomposePar reconstructPar rhoReactingFoam mpirun; do
    command -v "$exe" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: missing $exe" >&2; exit 11; }
done

export I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=slurm
export I_MPI_PIN=1
export I_MPI_PIN_DOMAIN=core
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1

ROOT="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR}"
TESTROOT="${ROOT}/_v2312_campaign_smoke_${SLURM_JOB_ID}"
cd "$ROOT"

[[ -d "$ROOT/cases" ]] || { echo "ERROR: submit from campaign root" >&2; exit 12; }
rm -rf "$TESTROOT"
mkdir -p "$TESTROOT"

cp -a "$ROOT/cases/FLOW/BC2_NOMINAL_v010/M1_108x36/C1" \
      "$TESTROOT/serial_nominal_M1_C1"
cp -a "$ROOT/cases/STIFFNESS/S3_HIGH_A1e9_Ta100/M1_108x36/C16" \
      "$TESTROOT/parallel16_high_stiffness_M1_C16"

for case_dir in \
    "$TESTROOT/serial_nominal_M1_C1" \
    "$TESTROOT/parallel16_high_stiffness_M1_C16"
do
    sed -Ei 's/^(startFrom[[:space:]]+)[^;]+;/\1startTime;/' "$case_dir/system/controlDict"
    sed -Ei 's/^(startTime[[:space:]]+)[^;]+;/\10;/' "$case_dir/system/controlDict"
    sed -Ei 's/^(endTime[[:space:]]+)[^;]+;/\11e-5;/' "$case_dir/system/controlDict"
    sed -Ei 's/^(writeInterval[[:space:]]+)[^;]+;/\11e-5;/' "$case_dir/system/controlDict"
    bash "$ROOT/run_case_orfoz.sh" "$case_dir"
done

test -f "$TESTROOT/serial_nominal_M1_C1/RUN_COMPLETE"
test -f "$TESTROOT/parallel16_high_stiffness_M1_C16/RUN_COMPLETE"
test -f "$TESTROOT/parallel16_high_stiffness_M1_C16/log.decomposePar"
test -f "$TESTROOT/parallel16_high_stiffness_M1_C16/log.reconstructPar"

echo "============================================================"
echo "V2312 ORFOZ PREFLIGHT PASSED"
echo "============================================================"
echo "Temporary results: $TESTROOT"
